home.title: Overview
home.headline: Your app, in motion
home.intro: {app} is an offline-first starter: Vue, Capacitor and a local SQLite database, dressed in shape, spring and colour.

detail.transitionNote: The page slid in on the slow spatial spring and faded through the one before it. Back plays it mirrored.
detail.appBarNote: Scroll: the big title leaves and the bar takes it, turning surface-container as content passes beneath.
detail.nestingNote: This push lives in the Overview tab's own history: other tabs keep their screen, and back unwinds only this one.

expressive.title: Material 3 Expressive
expressive.subtitle: Shapes, springs, wavy progress
expressive.text: Forty components from the m3e-vue package, built from Google's own Compose numbers: the 35 shapes, the spring motion scheme, the loading indicator and the wavy indicators.

color.title: Dynamic colour
color.subtitle: One seed, the 2025 colour spec
color.text: Every role in light and dark is generated from one seed. The colour studio changes it live: variant, contrast, custom colours.

shell.title: Adaptive shell
shell.subtitle: Bar on phones, rail from 600dp
shell.text: Destinations are data. Compact windows get the 64dp navigation bar; medium and larger get the navigation rail, each tab keeping its own history.

sqlite.title: SQLite
sqlite.subtitle: Kysely, offline-first
sqlite.text: SQLite compiled to WebAssembly, in a worker, against a real file in OPFS - no native plugin.

reactive.title: Reactive queries
reactive.subtitle: No manual invalidation
reactive.text: A write announces its tables and every query watching one refetches, debounced.

back.title: Android back
back.subtitle: Closes the top layer first
back.text: Back closes the topmost sheet, dialog or menu, then walks the tab's history, then returns to the start destination.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.subtitle: Fields stay in view
keyboard.text: The focused field scrolls back into view on every phase of the keyboard animation, and the navigation bar steps aside.

metrics.title: Query metrics
metrics.subtitle: Durations, refetches, cache
metrics.text: Every query is measured. Open the metrics sheet from the Orders screen to see what refetched and why.

demo.title: Orders
demo.empty: Seed some sample data, or create an order from the button.
demo.pipeliningNative: {count} reads issued together, then the same {count} awaited one at a time. The engine runs in a worker that executes statements one at a time, so issuing them together overlaps the message round trips and nothing else.
demo.pipeliningWeb: {count} reads issued together, then the same {count} awaited one at a time. In a desktop browser the round trip is nearly free - see the note under the result.
demo.ratioNative: Above 1x means the message round trips are overlapping. The worker is serial, so this can never show queries themselves running in parallel.
demo.ratioWeb: Expected on {platform}: the worker is serial and a desktop round trip is nearly free, so there is little to overlap. Measure on a device, where the round trip costs something.
demo.busHint: Every event a write published. The queries are subscribed to the same stream.
demo.deleteConfirm: Delete this order and its lines?
demo.engineSwitch: One engine everywhere - no bridge to pipeline
demo.loadFailed: The order form could not load.
demo.saveFailed: The order was not saved. Try again.
demo.actionFailed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
demo.clearText: Every order is deleted. Customers and products are put back.

bench.title: Benchmark
bench.intro: Every operation a screen in this app performs, run against the benchmark's own two tables so it never touches your data. Switch engines in Settings and run it again - the second run is compared against the first.
bench.seeded: Dataset built in {ms} ms - later runs reuse it

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.intro: Every Material 3 Expressive component in this kit, live, with the spec point each one shows.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.subtitle: Five sizes, shape morph, toggles, groups

overlays.title: Sheets and dialogs
overlays.subtitle: Bottom sheet, action sheet, menu, snackbar

pickers.title: Date and time
pickers.subtitle: Dates, times, wheels - dialog or sheet

tabs.title: Swipeable tabs
tabs.subtitle: Pages under the app bar, swiped between

contacts.title: Grouped list and index
contacts.subtitle: Sticky group titles, an A–Z rail

tables.title: Data table
tables.subtitle: Sort, select, sticky header and column

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.subtitle: A week strip over the day's visits

buttons.variantsNote: Filled for the main action, tonal and outlined below it, text for the least.
buttons.sizesNote: XS to XL, round or square. Press one: the corners tighten on the effects spring, without bounce.
buttons.toggleNote: Selected round buttons turn square; selected square ones turn round.
buttons.iconNote: Standard, filled, tonal, outlined; narrow, default and wide.
buttons.groupNote: Press and hold one: it widens by 15% and its neighbours give way.
buttons.connectedNote: Replaces segmented buttons: 2dp apart, the selected one rounds off completely.
buttons.splitNote: A main action with related ones; the trailing half rounds off while its menu is open.

fabs.sizesNote: Small, baseline, medium (new in Expressive) and large.
fabs.colorsNote: Container colours by default; the solid roles for more emphasis.
fabs.extendedNote: Tap it: the label collapses away and comes back on the spatial spring.
fabs.menuNote: Up to six actions spring out from the FAB's corner, staggered; it turns into a close button.

progress.driveNote: Drag to drive every determinate indicator below. The wave flattens under 10% and above 95%.
progress.loadingNote: Seven shapes morphing in a loop, for waits under a few seconds. It replaces the spinner.
progress.linearNote: Wavy, indeterminate, flat and thick. A gap and a stop dot mark where the track ends.
progress.circularNote: 48dp wavy or 40dp flat, and the half-ring gauge.
progress.skeletonNote: Framework7's placeholders in Material colours: the layout of what is coming, with one highlight sweeping the whole group.

shapes.morphNote: Pick any shape below: this one morphs into it on the default spatial spring.
shapes.libraryNote: All 35, built from the same vertices and rounding as Android's MaterialShapes.

navigation.primaryTabsNote: A 3dp indicator as wide as the content, springing between tabs.
navigation.barNote: The flexible 64dp bar: the indicator springs open, the icon fills, badges count or dot.
navigation.toolbarNote: Replaces the bottom app bar; standard or vibrant, with a paired FAB.
navigation.breadcrumbsNote: Where you are in a hierarchy; each level goes back up. Past four levels the middle folds into a menu.

overlays.sheetNote: Drag the handle, or content scrolled to its top: a fling or half the height dismisses.
overlays.standardNote: Beside the content, not over it: peek, half and full. Drag anywhere on it until it is open, then the list scrolls; pull down from the list's top to bring it back.
overlays.sheetText: Scroll to the end, then pull down from the top to dismiss.
overlays.dialogNote: For decisions that must not be missed. A hero icon centres the headline.
overlays.dialogText: It is removed from every device signed in to this account.
overlays.menuNote: Expressive menus in segments; the selected item takes the tertiary container, and Group by cascades into a submenu.
overlays.snackbarNote: Brief feedback with one action; it waits while touched.
overlays.side: Side sheets and the modal rail
overlays.sideNote: Filters slide in from the end edge; navigation from the start edge, closing itself once you choose.
overlays.tooltipsNote: Long-press the icon for its label; tap the text button for a rich tooltip.
overlays.richText: Every colour in the app is generated from this one, in light and dark.
overlays.notificationNote: Framework7's notification: drops in from the top, opens on tap, flies away when swiped sideways or up, and pauses while touched. Several stack, newest in front - tap the pill to spread them out.
overlays.orderText: SO-1024 · 12 lines · 48,300 DA, to deliver tomorrow morning.
overlays.fullscreenNote: Framework7's popup for a task that needs the whole screen. Save waits for a name; closing with changes asks before discarding them. From 600dp it becomes a basic dialog.
overlays.discardText: What you typed will be lost.
overlays.popoverNote: Anchored to what opened it, grows out of it, closes on a tap outside, Escape or back.
overlays.burstText: Synced from the field just now.

selection.stepperNote: Framework7's stepper: hold a button to repeat - across a wide range it speeds up. Tap the value to type it; the arrow keys step.
selection.switchesNote: The handle grows when on and travels on the fast spatial spring.
selection.checksNote: The check draws in; the radio dot springs.
selection.slidersNote: A slim handle splits the track; sizes XS to XL, with ticks and an inset icon.
selection.chipsNote: Filter chips toggle with a check; input chips can be removed.
selection.rangeNote: Two handles; a press moves the nearer one. The price pair keeps 1,000 apart; the hours snap to ticks.
selection.smartNote: Framework7's smart select: a row naming the choice opens a sheet of options - several with check marks and Done, one with radio marks that closes on its own. Long lists get a search field.

inputs.filledNote: The label floats up; errors replace the supporting text.
inputs.name: Full name
inputs.nameHint: As it appears on the invoice
inputs.amountInvalid: Enter a number with up to two decimals
inputs.outlinedNote: For dense forms; the label cuts into the outline.
inputs.searchViewNote: The bar opens into a full-screen view on one spring: recent searches first, then matches as you type. Back closes it.
inputs.dropdownNote: A select, and Framework7's autocomplete: type to filter the 58 wilayas - accents and case do not matter - while focus stays in the field.
inputs.richTextNote: Bold, lists and links for a visit report. What is stored is sanitised HTML: pasted scripts and styles never get in.
inputs.invalidLink: Use a web, email or phone address
inputs.signatureNote: Proof of delivery: ink that thickens when slow, kept as a draft, exported as a PNG. A typed name stands beside it for anyone who cannot sign on screen.
inputs.receivedByNote: The name of the person who signed

carousels.multiBrowseNote: Large items with smaller ones peeking: each compresses toward the edge and its picture slides under the mask. A fling carries as far as it goes and snaps to an item.
carousels.heroNote: One featured item between two small ones, centred once you leave the first. A fling moves one item.
carousels.uncontainedNote: Fixed-width items that coast freely; only the one leaving the edge compresses.
carousels.photosNote: Framework7's photo browser: swipe between photos, pinch or double-tap to zoom, pan when zoomed, swipe up or down to close. A tap hides the bar.
carousels.lazyNote: Space reserved before loading, a placeholder colour, a fade once decoded, and a failure that keeps its description.
carousels.missing: A photo that failed to load

surfaces.cardsNote: Elevated, filled and outlined; a whole card can be one target.
surfaces.accordionNote: Framework7's accordion list: one item open at a time, stepping out of the run as its own card.

offline.a: Yes. Every screen reads the database on the device, so a lost connection changes nothing you can see.

sync.a: This template has no server. Add one and it syncs into the local database; screens keep reading only the local copy.

storage.a: In the app's private storage, through SQLite compiled to WebAssembly - the same engine in the browser and on the phone.

export.a: Not yet in the template - a repository function over the orders table is all it takes.

surfaces.sortableNote: Framework7's sortable list: drag a handle, or long-press a stop and drag it. The others step aside and the page scrolls near its edges.

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.text: Stock reserved at the central warehouse

surfaces.infiniteNote: Framework7's infinite scroll: the next page loads as the end comes near. The third page fails once on purpose - retry it.

pickers.modalNote: Calendar or typed input in your locale's order; nothing is kept until OK.
pickers.dockedNote: From today on, Sundays closed. Arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down move through it.
pickers.rangeNote: Tap a start, then an end; the days between take the band.
pickers.sheetNote: Framework7's way: from the bottom, within thumb reach. Switch between the calendar and the wheel.
pickers.timeNote: Dial or keyboard; the clock follows your language's 12 or 24 hours.
pickers.timeSheetNote: Dial or wheel, in quarter hours.
pickers.dateWheelNote: Inline, in your language's order. Spin to a shorter month and the day follows.
pickers.wheelNote: Any values on drums - here a quantity and its unit.

scale.virtualNote: {count} rows, only the visible ones in the DOM. Pull down from the top to refresh.

tabs.title: Swipeable tabs
tabs.ordersNote: Swipe between tabs anywhere on the page; swipe a row left to archive it - the row wins over the pager.
tabs.paymentsNote: A carousel inside a tab keeps its own sideways drag.

tree.title: Treeview
tree.note: Framework7's treeview: the chevron opens a branch, a row selects. Dairy loads its products the first time it opens. Arrow keys walk the tree.

tables.ordersNote: Framework7's data table: tap a header to sort, again to reverse, again to clear. Select rows to total them. It scrolls inside its own height here, so the header and the order column stay put.

charts.lineNote: A line chart filled as an area: this year against last. Touch and slide along it to read both values; the gap is the months to come.
charts.barNote: Grouped bars, or stacked. Touch a rep to read the numbers.
charts.donutNote: Touch a segment or its legend entry to bring it to the centre.

chat.title: Route team
chat.subtitle: Amina, Karim and you
chat.start: This is the start of the conversation

lines.s1: Reminder: the new prices apply from Sunday.
lines.s2: Noted, I'll tell the shops on my route.
lines.s5: Two shops were closed, I'll go back Thursday.
lines.s6: Sunrise on the coast road, first visit at 7.
lines.s7: Beautiful. Can you push the 1L range on that route next week?
lines.s8: Yes, I'll add it to Tuesday's orders.
lines.s9: Sending the updated price list now
lines.o3: I can cover the north route tomorrow.
lines.o4: Thanks both, good week so far.
lines.o5: See you at the depot at 8.
lines.r4: I'll pass by the depot later.

route.title: Your route, in order
route.text: Every visit of the day in the order you drive it, with what each shop ordered last time.

orders.title: Orders in seconds
orders.text: Scan, adjust quantities, and the totals and promotions follow as you type.

offline.title: No signal, no problem
offline.text: Everything is kept on the phone and goes out as soon as there is a connection.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to see today's route.
login.forgotSent: A reset link would be sent to your email
login.hint: Demo: any email, with the password demo.

agenda.title: Route agenda
agenda.weekendText: The weekend: the route starts again on Sunday.

settings.title: Settings
settings.motionNote: Reduced keeps fades and morphs, and drops travel and bounce.

studio.title: Colour studio
studio.spec2025: Generated with the 2025 Expressive colour rules.
studio.spec2021: This variant uses the 2021 colour rules - Material applies the 2025 rules to Tonal spot, Expressive, Vibrant and Neutral only.
studio.contrastNote: Higher contrast separates text from its surface for low vision and bright light.
studio.pickNote: Picked in HCT, the space Material builds schemes in: hue stays put while tone and chroma move.
